partners.mechanism_chain: CEP290 (HGNC:2587) —DISRUPTS→ intraflagellar transport (IFT); intraflagellar transport (IFT) —LEADS_TO→ Bardet-Biedl syndrome (MONDO:0015229); TUBB2B (HGNC:12116) —DISRUPTS→ primary cilium assembly and function; primary cilium assembly and function —LEADS_TO→ complex cortical dysplasia with other brain malformations 7 (MONDO:0012399); intraflagellar transport (IFT) —BINDS→ primary cilium assembly and function. Mutations in CEP290 (a key component of the IFT machinery) disrupt intraflagellar transport, leading to Bardet-Biedl syndrome. Separately, mutations in TUBB2B, a component of the ciliary cytoskeleton, disrupt primary cilium assembly and function, leading to complex cortical dysplasia with other brain malformations 7. Both IFT and primary cilium assembly/function are tightly linked processes, thus representing a shared pathway convergence.

partners.mechanism_chain: BBS1 (HGNC:13343) —DISRUPTS→ Ciliary protein trafficking and assembly (GO:0034374); Ciliary protein trafficking and assembly (GO:0034374) —DECREASES→ Hedgehog signaling pathway (GO:0007271); PTCH1 (HGNC:9035) —DISRUPTS→ Hedgehog signaling pathway (GO:0007271); Hedgehog signaling pathway (GO:0007271) —LEADS_TO→ SMO (HGNC:10675); SMO (HGNC:10675) —LEADS_TO→ Bardet-Biedl syndrome (MONDO:0015229); SMO (HGNC:10675) —LEADS_TO→ Basal cell carcinoma (MONDO:0011556). Loss-of-function mutations in BBS genes like BBS1 disrupt normal ciliary function, which in turn leads to dysregulation of the Hedgehog signaling pathway.
